predecessor.status: Unchanged strict samples-reference acceptance; no historical run may be relabeled as this profile.

design: Additive retrospective source-grounded CLI-era partial facet, frozen before inspecting original native attempt results. Census run status is discovery only and did not select acceptance.
effectiveExecution: engine.command overrides agent execution. The natural-language prompt is intent, not proof that its requested cache/issue/update/label actions ran.
eligibleOpportunity: Original pull_request event attempt with this exact source/compiled command profile and original triggering PR identity. Non-PR noop branches have no comment-effect opportunity and are not failures of the samples contract.

partialEffect.expectedBody: ✅ smoke-ci: safeoutputs CLI comment + comment-memory run (RUN_ID)
partialEffect.predicate: Original protected processing receipt or independently captured native comment proves this exact body was persisted on the original triggering PR, with stable comment identity and original native creation timestamp.
partialEffect.assignment: Native comment creation timestamp, inclusive window start and exclusive window end; deduplicate stable comment identity across observations.

requestValidity: A source-bound original safeoutputs add_comment request is intrinsic request creation only, not a persisted comment.
nonattainment: An original protected failure/denial receipt can establish a failed requested effect; green/red job conclusions alone cannot establish either outcome.
fullAcceptance: Unknown unless comment-memory persistence, restored cross-run cache/repo-memory bytes and relevant hide-older semantics are independently established. The declared prompt's unexecuted actions are not acceptance evidence.
contribution: Protected processor identity plus run/attempt, source and triggering target join can establish shared workflow contribution. An editable issue footer is insufficient.
comparability: Compare only compatible same-profile complete disjoint periods. Do not compare CLI-era comment counts to five-sample-era effect counts.
missingness: Partial selected attempts are not a full period cohort. Missing logs/receipts/native state remain null. No samples-era opportunity is manufactured from a CLI run.
costs: Not measured; no LLM invocation is inferred from engine configuration when engine.command overrides it.
decision: Not rated; no keep threshold or cost evidence supplied.
